title: 多源质量—多材料—多距离联合引力诊断（模拟/计划协议）

hypotheses.H0: 普适G0，已建模的质量分布、非球对称和设备系统误差；归一化径向Q符合对应完整源模型，材料差D=0
hypotheses.H1: 单一有限程、线性可分离的组成依赖媒介；特定近似下D矩阵rank<=1
hypotheses.H2: 多个媒介/环境屏蔽；允许更高秩或非Yukawa的径向响应
hypotheses.H_U: 通用源依赖幅度uA；单一来源材料差可为0且与质量标定退化

geometry.source: spherical where applicable; measured radius and multipole corrections

analysis: Q radial derivative with propagated covariance
test rank with noise-aware singular values
compare single/two mediator and nuisance confounds
decision_rules: No claims of new forces from a single fit
No posterior claim from significance without systematic uncertainty
Null rank-one matrix alone is not evidence
Require independent instrument replication and unlocked blind conditions
Results remain hypotheses until physical observations
safety: No hardware motion/power control is included
Industrial mechanical/electrical safety review required before any physical prototype
Do not imply hazardous magnet or high voltage procedures are validated
